Method: Opt-in ActivitySource scopes; timings are inclusive and nested stages must not be added twice. Thread start/end tags distinguish dispatcher and workers. Per-thread allocations are deliberately unavailable across a thread change. No source text, document identity, paths or UIA transport is recorded.
Boundaries: Source scanners; semantic/correspondence validation; pinned parsing before the existing graph layout callback; existing graph layout; SVG generation after layout; SVG sanitisation; SharpVectors Read; native drawing freeze/wrapper; geometry correspondence; overlay creation; native first presentation; first interaction; selection/inspector update; private source validation; cleanup.

Mermaider 0.15.1 exposes graph layout callbacks for Flowchart/State/Class/ER, not the Sequence pipeline. Sequence parsing/layout/SVG remains a labelled renderer.pipeline span; no parser-only time is invented.

SharpVectors Read creates native DrawingGroup geometry internally. That read is timed together; final WPF freeze/image wrapping is separate. No converter fork, extra graph engine or production budgets changed.
